S1_purpose.action_unit: one D-1 14:00 KST decision covering 72 cells (3 groups x 24 hourly targets 01:00-00:00)
S1_purpose.output_semantics: action under the combined official loss, not necessarily a conditional mean

S4_metric.aggregation: equal-group means; Total = 0.5*(1-NMAE)+0.5*FICR; no intermediate rounding
S4_metric.parity: local scorer EQUIVALENT; exact-Total resampling EQUIVALENT on complete selected day sets

active_deficits.title: forecast reference/run vs declared availability vs valid time vs temporal support are not separated
active_deficits.mechanism: wrong run/revision/lead/accumulation contaminates all downstream transforms and can hide basis-time leakage
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: source x forecast_reference x available_at x valid_time x variable x level x grid key/schema audit with uniqueness and join coverage

active_deficits.title: evaluation-population and label-availability support are not stratified
active_deficits.mechanism: official low-output filter plus equal-group pooling changes which population each slice represents
active_deficits.observable: label presence key-observable; eligibility needs an authorized count-only projection
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: group x month x hour/lead presence-and-eligibility count cube, values suppressed

active_deficits.title: no consolidated diagnostic lineage/coverage registry
active_deficits.mechanism: oracle, leaky, screening and deployable evidence get conflated and can close the wrong stage
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: diagnostic index with population, keys, policy, availability class, artifact hash, contamination, status

active_deficits.title: source/run missingness is not modeled as an operational state
active_deficits.mechanism: whole-source outage vs single missing cell carry different information loss; median/renormalization hides it
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: presence bitset plus deterministic fallback transition table

active_deficits.title: exact metric inference is not integrated with action-mechanism diagnostics
active_deficits.mechanism: pooled Total delta hides NMAE/FICR trade-offs, equal-group effects and 6%/8% tier migration
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: contract test that the strict receipt exposes component/group/fold/lead/regime/boundary/tier/count/alignment/policy/fit-surface fields

active_deficits.title: implemented representation is not active prepared lineage
active_deficits.mechanism: module presence mistaken for coverage suppresses real audits
active_deficits.evidence: prepare manifest has 820 unique names and zero geom__/seq__/clim prefixes
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: builder call graph plus exact feature-prefix set difference

active_deficits.title: the development surface is adaptively reused and cannot become a fresh holdout
active_deficits.mechanism: repeated human-guided inspection creates selection dependence that refit/bootstrap/MCS cannot erase

active_deficits.title: future operational state/curtailment cause is structurally unobservable at inference
active_deficits.mechanism: removing or restoring curtailed production changes the estimand
active_deficits.observable: not observable at inference under the supplied schema
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: schema-only target-definition and operational-field availability receipt

active_deficits.title: engine cannot represent node depth, migration hypotheses, residual children, causal re-entry, pause vs success, or atomic lineage
active_deficits.mechanism: stage-linear one-record-per-stage loop closes stages without residual descent and can call below-target exhaustion a terminal halt
active_deficits.smallest_diagnostic: contract tests over synthetic envelopes in tmp_path

active_deficits.title: temporal collapse at prepare time
active_deficits.mechanism: each row is a single valid-time snapshot, so the 24 lead hours of one issuance are unlinked; no lag, lead-window, rolling, difference, trend or ramp operator exists among the 820 deployed names, and the information cannot be recovered downstream
active_deficits.gate: FD1 must first prove that all lead hours of one forecast_id share one data_available_kst_dtm at or before the D-1 14:00 basis time

active_deficits.title: permutation collapse at prepare time
active_deficits.mechanism: the 9 GFS and 16 LDAPS points enter only through permutation-invariant order statistics plus fixed IDW/nearest weights, so which point held which value is destroyed and a horizontal gradient is provably not a function of the 820 columns
active_deficits.note: this is a new local deficit, distinct from the closed centred-scalar-MSLP-gradient exact-transfer axis
